zh_CN: 点一个鱼缸，用渔网把它补满
en: Tap a tank to fill it with the net

zh_CN: 被压住的气泡要先点开上面的
en: Pop the bubbles on top first

zh_CN: 锁链泡：每装满一缸，数字减 1
en: Chained: each full tank lowers the number

zh_CN: 限时缸：倒计时归零前装满它
en: Timed tank: fill it before time runs out

zh_CN: 迷雾泡：看不出里面是什么鱼。每破一个别的气泡数字减 1，到 0 就看清了
en: Fog: the fish are hidden. Each other bubble you pop lowers the number. At 0 they show

zh_CN: 冰封泡：冻住了点不了。冰晶连着的气泡破掉一个，它就解冻
en: Frozen: it can't be tapped. Pop a bubble it is linked to and it thaws

zh_CN: 结伴鱼：点一条，两条一起走，各进各的缸
en: Buddies: tap one and both go. Each finds its own tank

zh_CN: 现在没有能直接进缸的鱼
en: No fish can go straight in

zh_CN: 今天重玩的奖励已领完
现在离开会失去 1 条生命
吹出一个新气泡，接着闯关
en: Blow a fresh bubble and go on

zh_CN: 从这关起，中途离开会失去 1 条生命
en: From here on leaving mid-level costs a life

zh_CN: 后面还有气泡会掉下来
en: More bubbles will drop in later

zh_CN: 吹走暂存槽里的鱼，接着闯关
en: Blow the waiting fish back and keep going

zh_CN: 解开锁链和冰封，接着闯关
en: Break the chains and ice and keep going

zh_CN: 多一个鱼缸，这一关更好过。
en: One more bowl makes this level easier.

zh_CN: 今天的免费金币领完了
看广告或花金币再试一次
en: Watch an ad or pay coins to retry
